description: Boulder County Public Works publishes a point layer of stormwater manholes. Its schema includes junction type, rim elevation, incoming and outgoing invert elevations, road location, ownership and maintenance. These junction locations and elevation attributes can support stormwater-network representation and hydraulic simulation with compatible pipe data. The county describes a combination of April to December 2017 field collection, drainage plans and later field and spatial work. The layer is used in its asset-management system and updated as needed. Elevation units, vertical datum, missing values and connections between the manholes and particular pipe segments were not established from the inspected metadata. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue. The county overview has inconsistent licence wording; this record preserves the explicit layer-feed licence URL.
